claims.claim: 11 案中 6 案原文明确触发变更走全局/无渐进/绕过保护路径(CS、GCP 数据、CF-2019、CF-11、CF-12、AFD-09)
claims.quote: The SOP allowed a non-emergency rule change to go globally into production without a staged rollout.

claims.claim: 代码走渐进发布而配置/数据不走,4 案原文直说
claims.quote: This system does not perform gradual rollouts, but rather propagates changes within seconds to the entire fleet of servers in our network

claims.claim: 可计算 TTD 的 8 案中位数约 3 分钟(派生;范围 1-23 分钟)
claims.quote: 09:48 Global disruption identified by Fastly monitoring

claims.claim: 首次发现来源原文明确为自动信号 6/11,明确客户报告 0/11,5 案未明说或未披露
claims.quote: The first automated test detected the issue at 11:31 and manual investigation started at 11:32.

claims.claim: TTD≤5 分钟的 6 案中 4 案主要缓解超过 1 小时:检测快、定位/缓解慢
claims.quote: We were confident that the Bot Management configuration file was the trigger for the incident.

claims.claim: 11 案无一主要靠自动回滚缓解;自动化最多做到停止传播或自动重启
claims.quote: Since the latest ‘last known good’ (LKG) version was updated with the conflicting metadata, we chose not to revert to it.

claims.claim: 离线验证漏检的共性:合法但未见过的输入形状触发潜伏代码路径,常有延迟(14 天、27 天、6 周、15 天、约 5 分钟)
claims.quote: This defect escaped detection due to a gap in our pre-production validation, since not all features are validated across different control plane build versions.

claims.claim: canary 结构性盲区:延迟发作的故障与需要别的变更才触发的代码路径
claims.quote: the code path that failed was never exercised during this rollout due to needing a policy change that would trigger the code.

claims.claim: 异步崩溃让健康门控放行坏配置
claims.quote: Because the data plane crash surfaced asynchronously, after approximately five minutes, the configuration passed through the protection safeguards and propagated to later stages.

claims.claim: 渐进应用限制了爆炸半径(正例)
claims.quote: This incident did not impact all BYOIP customers because the configuration change was applied iteratively and not instantaneously across all BYOIP customers.

claims.claim: 定位慢的原因:误判为攻击、间歇症状、工具依赖故障设施
claims.quote: After we initially wrongly suspected the symptoms we were seeing were caused by a hyper-scale DDoS attack

claims.claim: 缓解后恢复长尾(群体效应/积压)常长于检测+定位
claims.quote: It took up to ~2h 40 mins to fully resolve in us-central-1 as we throttled task creation

claims.claim: CrowdStrike 04:09 发布、05:27 revert(78 分钟为发布→revert,非 TTD)
claims.quote: The defect in the content update was reverted on Friday, July 19, 2024 at 05:27 UTC.

claims.claim: Google 2 分钟内 SRE 分诊、10 分钟内定位、40 分钟内 red-button 推完
claims.quote: Within 2 minutes, our Site Reliability Engineering team was triaging the incident. Within 10 minutes, the root cause was identified

claims.claim: AFD-29 15:41 影响开始,15:48 监控检测,15:43 保护系统自动冻结
claims.quote: The issue started at 15:41 UTC and was detected by monitoring at 15:48 UTC, prompting our investigation.

claims.claim: AFD-09 影响 07:50 开始,遥测 08:13 检测(23 分钟)
claims.quote: 08:13 UTC on 09 October 2025 – Our telemetry detected resource availability loss across multiple AFD edge sites.

claims.claim: AWS 50 分钟定位到 DynamoDB DNS(11:48 PM→12:38 AM PDT)
claims.quote: By 12:38 AM on October 20, our engineers had identified DynamoDB’s DNS state as the source of the outage.

claims.claim: CF-2019 部署后 3 分钟首个 PagerDuty(外部合成测试)
claims.quote: Three minutes later the first PagerDuty page went out indicating a fault with the WAF.

claims.claim: CF-12 08:50 自动告警声明事故,25 分钟恢复
claims.quote: 08:50 / INCIDENT declared / Automated alerts
2026-02-20 18:13 / Cloudflare engaged / Cloudflare engaged for failures on one.one.one.one

claims.claim: Meta 官方复盘无任何时间戳;审计工具 bug 未拦住命令
claims.quote: Our systems are designed to audit commands like these to prevent mistakes like this, but a bug in that audit tool prevented it from properly stopping the command.

claims.claim: CF-2019 自认流量下跌告警太慢
claims.quote: The first alert for the global traffic drop took too long to fire.
